metrics.title: Estimated residents
metrics.note: ONS mid-2024 LSOA estimates, England and Wales. Postal-region estimates allocated by current postcode shares, not address/resident locations. Geography coverage at least 95%, population coverage at least 98%. Single-year ages are supporting information; 90+ group assumed 92.5 for approximate mean age. Housing statistics remain Census 2021. Scotland unavailable.

metrics.title: Owner occupation (incl. shared)
metrics.note: Census Day 21 March 2021, England and Wales. Estimated postal totals: LSOA counts allocated by postcode shares, not address or resident locations. At least 95% map-postcode geography coverage required. Counts are not current population estimates. Scotland unavailable. Percentages refer to occupied households. Overcrowded means negative bedroom occupancy rating.

metrics.title: Gigabit availability
metrics.note: Unweighted mean of residential postcode availability percentages, not an area-wide premises percentage. Minimum five matched postcodes. Availability is not experienced speed or take-up; gigabit includes cable as well as fibre.

metrics.title: Superfast availability
metrics.note: Unweighted mean of residential postcode availability percentages, not an area-wide premises percentage. Minimum five matched postcodes. Availability is not experienced speed or take-up; gigabit includes cable as well as fibre.

metrics.title: Unable to receive 10 Mbps
metrics.note: Unweighted mean of residential postcode availability percentages, not an area-wide premises percentage. Minimum five matched postcodes. Availability is not experienced speed or take-up; gigabit includes cable as well as fibre.

metrics.title: Recorded crime incidents
metrics.note: Police-recorded incidents, not personal risk. Anonymised points assigned to approximate postal polygons. Rates divide by estimated mid-2024 residents; visitors inflate town-centre rates. At least 250 estimated residents. Scotland/NI not covered. No observations stays grey, not zero. Source force/month gaps can undercount; see data provenance. Regions with territorial-force gaps are masked. British Transport Police records are excluded for period consistency.

metrics.title: Nearest mapped rail station
metrics.note: Median straight-line distance from postcode reference points to the nearest mapped stations. Detail areas only. Volunteer/business listings can be incomplete; study-area edges can overstate distances. Not walking distance, travel time, capacity, accessibility or service quality.

availability.title: Energy efficiency / EPC
availability.reason: Official bulk access needs GOV.UK One Login. Import a permitted CSV using --epc-csv; certificates must be deduplicated per property. No EPC values have been invented.

availability.title: Planning activity
availability.reason: The national Planning Data planning-application dataset currently reports no applications. A council feed is required; absent data is not zero activity.
